{{Conjecture|legends}}
Following [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Death/Legends|death]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Crassus]] was [[Burial/Legends|buried]] in a '''tomb''' located in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. The tomb's location was eventually forgotten, and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was thought that the [[Gauntlet of Crassus]], an artifact created by Crassus, was also located inside the structure.<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
